title: Referrer Gas Bundle Bonus (Residential Electricity Supply Referral Credits)
content:
**Rule.** When a Beacon Ridge gas agreement under Residential Natural Gas Supply on the referring agreement's premise is active and on a fixed-rate gas plan, the fixed-bundle referral bonus of 10.00 USD is added to the Residential Electricity Supply referral credit; when such a gas agreement is active on a plan that is not fixed-rate, the other-bundle referral bonus of 5.00 USD is added; when no gas agreement on that premise is active, nothing is added.

**Records read.** The status of the gas agreement recorded at the same premise as the electricity agreement receiving the credit, and the rate type of the gas plan on that gas agreement.

| Gas agreement on the referring agreement's premise | Gas plan fixed-rate | Referrer bundle bonus |
|---|---|---|
| active | yes | 10.00 USD |
| active | no | 5.00 USD |
| enrollment pending, drop pending or closed | any | nothing |
| none | not applicable | nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** A referrer whose premise has an active gas agreement on a fixed-rate gas plan adds 10.00 USD; the same referrer whose gas agreement there has closed adds nothing. A gas agreement at a different premise of the same customer does not count.
